Marissa —

I've pulled the RTO test snapshot from 2026-11-01 and a compact runbook excerpt. Attachments: rto-snapshot-2026-11-01.pdf, runbook-summary.xlsx. Notes:

- The RTO snapshot is from our standard recovery drill (simulated region failure). It shows median recovery of ~3.8 minutes for control-plane failover and ~6.2 minutes end-to-end for micro-batch workload under standard load; 95th percentile spikes to ~10.5 minutes under sustained peak (95th percentile measured over 24h).
- RPO for model KV cache is effectively zero for active sessions (KV-sync) and 5–10s for streaming persistence during the test configuration.
- We've redacted customer request IDs per policy; logs include anonymized request hashes.

If Alice wants the raw CSV logs or a test play-by-play, we can provide a sanitized export (takes ~1 business day).
